acquiring new accounts and deepening relationships 
with existing clients, ensuring sustainable revenue 
momentum. The market opportunity remains immense. 
While we are market leaders in India, we are still 
challengers in international markets—offering significant 
headroom for growth.

Our revenue growth is underpinned by the strength and 
diversity of our digital fabric portfolio, which includes: 
Network fabric; Interaction fabric; Cloud fabric;  
IoT fabric; and specialised Media industry solutions.
Each of these domains contributes uniquely to our top 
line, driven by increasing customer relevance, expanding 
solution capabilities and strategic investments in new 
platforms and services. These efforts are translating into 
a growing share of enterprise wallets.

Profitability Drivers
These initiatives aim to realign our asset base, improve 
resource utilisation and support investments in growth 
areas—helping to gradually strengthen profitability 
alongside revenue.
Our profitability is being driven by a combination of 
scale, strategic focus and operational efficiency:
 
�
Operating Leverage: As we scale, we benefit from 
improved cost efficiencies and margin expansion.
 
�
Business Model Optimisation: We are undertaking 
multiple strategic initiatives to enhance long-term 
value creation, including:

of non-core assets

Together, these efforts reflect a dual approach to 
growth—organic, through internal efficiencies and 
strategic focus and inorganic, through asset optimisation 
and portfolio realignment—ensuring a resilient and 
scalable path to sustained profitability. 
Our RoCE, EBITDA Margin and other KPIs have moderated due to certain management actions taken over the past 
two years, though performance remains aligned with expectations. The margin pressure was driven by increased 
provisions in parts of the SAARC region, impacted by geopolitical factors, and from performance of our subsidiaries 
and recent acquisitions. Despite these factors, our core EBITDA margins for FY 24-25 remained steady at 23.3%. 
The new integrations, Kaleyra and Switch are nearing inflection points, with synergies expected to materialise in 
the coming quarters.
We also monetised land assets and divested from our payment solutions business and NetFoundryTM, enhancing 
profitability and reducing net debt. Continued debt reduction and profitability improvements are expected to 
support RoCE growth, with key metrics returning to target ranges as we are realising the synergies.
